title: MMRA  MicroRNA Master Regulator Analysis
protocol: Perform differential microRNA expression analysis using the ks.boot function from the R package ‘Matching’.
Estimate the false discovery rate by reshuffling samples 1000 times and computing the mean value of differentially expressed microRNAs.
Compare the number of differentially expressed microRNAs in the pipeline with those identified during permutation-based FDR estimation.
Perform network analysis using the ARACNe information-theoretic algorithm.
Download and include ARACNe software in the pipeline for inferring transcriptional interactions.
Set up an expression matrix X by row-wise combining the entire mRNA expression TCGA dataset with the expression values of a single microRNA under analysis.
Generate a linear expression matrix Y by applying the operation Yij=2^Xij to the elements of matrix X.
Apply log2 transformation to the normalized dataset Y.
Filter out genes with a standard deviation lower than 1.2 from the transformed dataset.
Run ARACNe imposing the microRNA as the only hub of the network to identify interactions between the microRNA and mRNAs.
